HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose

9. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)

   B. Ignore prices in shops
